title: Jellyfin Concurrent Stream Ceiling
dataSources: Tautulli/Plex playback (`tautulli:play`), Jellyfin activity (`jellyfin:activity`), Spotify recently-played (`spotify:play`), Steam player and achievements (`steam:player`), Sonarr events (`sonarr:event`).
app: Plex / Jellyfin (Tautulli), Sonos, Spotify, Steam, Xbox/PSN, and the *arr stack (Sonarr/Radarr) APIs and webhooks via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=jellyfin:activity
| bin _time span=5m
| stats dc(session_id) as concurrent_streams by _time
| eventstats max(concurrent_streams) as peak_streams
| where concurrent_streams=peak_streams AND peak_streams>3
| sort - _time
description: Shows the moments your Jellyfin server hit its peak simultaneous streaming demand, useful for sizing storage, network, and transcoding headroom.
value: Concurrency is the load pattern that hurts self-hosted media most; this chart tells you how close your family habits get to the platform's edge.
implementation: Ingest Jellyfin session activity; review peak concurrent stream windows and correlate them with server metrics if playback stutters.
visualization: Timechart of concurrent streams with the peak highlighted.
grandmaExplanation: It counts how many people were using the media server at once when it was busiest.
